review:
Hacksaw's Christmas expanding-wild game. Wild Santas expand downwards when they're part of a win, and each reel can hold one.

When an expanding Santa passes through a Wild Gift, it becomes a 2x to 200x multiplier – and several multiplied Santas in one win add together. Three FS give 10 spins of Night Before Christmas, with more Santas and gifts, and three more scatters add four. Rated 3/5, 12,500x max, top RTP 96.22%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 88.02% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
